sessions.title: HIE Maturity Models: Where Do We Stand and Where Do We Need to Go?
sessions.label: Panel 1 · GCC & MENA Discussion Panel
sessions.description: Drawing on the O3C Interoperability Maturity Model and the Civitas Health Data Utility Framework, this panel will map HIEs in the region to a common HIE maturity ladder. Panelists will debate what Level 3 vs Level 5 maturity means in practice, what the most common obstacles to progression are, and what investment and governance decisions are required to reach Health Data Utility status.

sessions.label: Panel 2 · Thematic Discussion Panel
sessions.description: Without a terminology service governing the codes that flow through an HIE, semantic drift is inevitable: local codes accumulate, LOINC adoption stalls, immunisation records lose their 360° view, and public health reports become unreliable. This panel will explain the upstream/downstream model: upstream services intercept and validate or normalise codes at ingestion, while downstream services map between standard systems to repurpose stored codes for immunisation registries, population health phenotyping and other use cases.
